long.title: 12 Animal Facts That Sound FAKE But Are 100% Real (TRUE or FALSE?)
long.comment:
📝 SCORE CHECK: how many did you get out of 12? 👇

Answer key: FALSE = flamingos born pink, ostrich fastest, duck quack doesn't echo. Everything else is REAL.

Which one do you STILL not believe?
long.description:
TRUE or FALSE? Cube-shaped poop, three hearts, a mammal that glows... most of these sound made up, and most are real. Three are fakes. Guess before the 3-second timer, keep score, and drop your score out of 12 in the comments 👇

0:00 Play along
0:20 Wombats poop cubes?
1:19 Octopuses have three hearts?
2:02 Sea otters hold hands while they sleep?
2:53 Flamingos are born pink?
3:35 A starfish can regrow a lost arm?
4:18 A group of crows is called a murder?
5:14 A platypus glows under ultraviolet light?
5:58 The ostrich is the fastest animal on land?
6:54 A duck's quack doesn't echo?
7:35 Hummingbirds can fly backwards?
8:25 A mantis shrimp can punch hard enough to crack aquarium glass?
9:07 Elephants can't jump?
9:58 Scores

Subscribe: tomorrow it's the myths about the animals in your own house.

shorts.title: Do Wombats Really Poop Cubes? 🟫
shorts.description:
TRUE or FALSE? Wombats poop cubes. Guess before the timer, then comment if you got it right 👇 

Bonus fact: Wombats leave their cubes on rocks and logs to mark their territory, and the flat sides stop them rolling away.

Full quiz episode on the channel.
